equations.meaning: The organizational analogue of the spine's prompt-construction step: a bounded query is drawn from a pre-existing organizational state under a declared scope rather than treated as an unconditioned starting point.

Any LLM output re-entering an organizational dialogue is knowledge-like, not validated knowledge, regardless of fluency or citation; a dialogic prompting routine can surface a candidate insight but cannot, by fluency alone, certify it as organizational knowledge.

equations.label: unlabeled (5, Reflexive Reconfiguration stage)
equations.meaning: The organizational analogue of retention; a policy change earns the word "learning" only if it survives a Human-Return-style audit after LLM support is withdrawn, i.e. "LLM-present policy behaviour ≠ demonstrated organizational retention" (the organizational reading of the individual-scale non-collapse "assisted performance ≠ unaided Human Return").

equations.label: unlabeled (§2, falsifier condition)
equations.section: 2 Introduction: From Communication Channel to an Organizational Readout Loop
equations.text: no H_org,n+1 ≠ H_org,n attributable to the processing
equations.meaning: Falsifier for the claim that LLM-mediated processing of organizational linguistic traces is a retention event: if no traceable residue appears in later organizational readout/policy/practice, the claim reduces to ordinary information throughput with no retention-level effect.

equations.label: unlabeled (§5.1, provenance ledger)
equations.text: Λ(e_i) = ⟨ Prov_i, Tier_i, Def_i, Reader_i, Falsifier_i ⟩
equations.meaning: The per-transition provenance ledger the programme requires of every load-bearing arrow; the original's "access logs," "rationale fields," and "policy diffs" indicators are read as partial, organization-scale analogues of this ledger, not yet the full ledger.

equations.label: unlabeled (§5.2, AVRH)
equations.meaning: AVRH (tension between human values and AI outputs can stimulate value reflection and capability growth) reformulated against the spine's Difference-Resistance-Agency constitutive conditions: "tension" is read as Difference, "guardrails" as Resistance, and "capability growth" must be tested as retained organizational Agency rather than assumed from assisted performance.

equations.label: P1
equations.text: Connectivity quality: Elective Connectivity quality predicts the breadth and safety of linguistic assets available for learning.
equations.meaning: Falsifier: a held-out organizational comparison shows no reproducible association between governance-quality measures and the breadth or safety of the resulting linguistic-asset corpus, beyond ordinary data-hygiene practice.

equations.label: P2
equations.text: Activation clarity: Capability Activation routines predict concept clarity and perceived value alignment.
equations.meaning: Falsifier: structured dialogic-prompting sessions show no incremental clarity or alignment effect beyond ordinary team meetings or documentation review.

equations.label: P3
equations.text: Reconfiguration cadence: Reflexive Reconfiguration cadence predicts policy-update rates and learning-KPI improvements.
equations.meaning: Falsifier: cadence of reflection sessions shows no relationship to policy-diff rate once leadership attention and resourcing are controlled for.

equations.label: P4
equations.text: Reviewer diversity: Reviewer diversity strengthens clarity and alignment (moderation).
equations.meaning: A loose analogy to, not an instance of, the programme's own Independence Ladder for AI-model checking, which governs model independence, not human reviewer diversity. Falsifier: diversity of reviewers shows no moderating effect once reviewer count and domain expertise are held constant.

equations.label: P5
equations.text: Over-reliance: Over-reliance on LLM outputs weakens the P2-P3 relationships (negative moderation), paralleling K_like ≠ K_validated at organizational scale.
equations.meaning: Falsifier: measured reliance on LLM output shows no negative moderation of the P2/P3 relationships.

equations.label: P6
equations.text: Minimization trade-off: Data minimization reduces decontextualization risk without lowering activation benefits.
equations.meaning: Falsifier: data minimization reduces measured activation benefit in proportion to, or more than, the risk reduction achieved.

equations.label: P7
equations.text: Dissent protocols: Formal dissent protocols reduce power-capture risk.
equations.meaning: Parallels the programme's own non-collapse that diagnosing a compression is not the same as attributing responsibility for it: a protocol's existence is not itself proof that capture has been diagnosed or resolved. Falsifier: organizations with formal dissent protocols show no reduction in power-capture indicators relative to matched organizations without them.

equations.label: P8
equations.text: SECI complementarity: SECI-practicing organizations experience complementary gains from OLW routines.
equations.meaning: Falsifier: SECI-practicing and non-SECI-practicing organizations show no differential gain from adopting OLW routines.
